controls.positive_control: known anti-TAA VHH (e.g., a published anti-HER2 nanobody) — must enrich
controls.negative_irrelevant_antigen: same pool vs BSA / a non-TAA protein — winners must NOT enrich
controls.negative_unrelated_binder: non-binding/unrelated VHH on display — must NOT enrich

specificity_decision: keep VHHs that bind the target but not the relatives (target-selective)
biparatopic_stretch: pair a non-overlapping VHH with an overlapping one for a biparatopic/bispecific construct (stronger avidity / dual-epitope engagement)  [stretch]
